lessons.title: Ma famille
lessons.oneGoal: Students understand that 'famille' means family and can identify their own family members

main.activity: Family photo sharing circle with visual support
visualSupports: Large diverse family photos on wall
Hand gestures for maman (rocking baby) and papa (strong arms)
Picture cards showing different family structures

closing.activity: Students point to their family photo and whisper 'ma famille' - celebrates diversity

lessons.realWorldConnection: Everyone has a family and can talk about who lives at home

lessons.title: Qui est dans ma famille?
lessons.oneGoal: Students can name 3 basic family members using simple French words

main.activity: Family member identification with movement and photos
visualSupports: Family member picture cards showing diversity
Height gestures for frère (brother)
Inclusive photos showing different family structures

closing.activity: Students point to family members in photos and name them in French

lessons.realWorldConnection: Children can describe who lives in their house

lessons.title: Ma famille à moi
lessons.oneGoal: Students can point to and name their family members in photos or drawings

main.activity: Personalized family sharing with possessive language
visualSupports: Hand gestures showing possession (pointing to self, then family)
Visual cue cards for 'mon' (masculine) vs 'ma' (feminine)
Student family photos arranged on personal posters

closing.activity: Students hold up their family poster and say one family member name

lessons.realWorldConnection: Children show family photos and talk about them

lessons.title: Les familles sont différentes
lessons.oneGoal: Students understand that families can look different and that's wonderful

main.activity: Celebrating family diversity with visual exploration
visualSupports: Photo collection: single parents, grandparents raising children, mixed race families, adopted families, same-gender parents, big and small families
Heart gesture for 'spécial'
Beauty gesture (hands to face, smile) for 'beau'
Comparison charts showing different family structures

closing.activity: Students look at their own family poster and say 'Ma famille est spéciale'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Families come in many forms - single parents, grandparents, step-families, adopted families

lessons.title: Qu'est-ce qu'on fait ensemble?
lessons.oneGoal: Students can identify one activity they do with family members

main.activity: Family activities introduction with action and movement
visualSupports: Action photos: families eating together, playing games, watching movies, reading books
Large gesture cards for each activity
TPR actions: eating motion, playing motion, watching motion

closing.activity: Students do one activity gesture and say the French word

lessons.realWorldConnection: Families eat meals together, play games, watch movies

lessons.title: Notre maison
lessons.oneGoal: Students can name where their family lives and spends time

main.activity: Family homes and rooms exploration with inclusive housing types
visualSupports: Diverse home photos: houses, apartments, condos, mobile homes, different sizes
Room photos showing different home layouts and decorating styles
Simple house outline template for drawing
Activity-room matching cards

closing.activity: Students point to their house drawing and say 'Ma maison'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Families live in houses, apartments, different types of homes

lessons.title: Nos traditions familiales
lessons.oneGoal: Students understand that families have special traditions and celebrations

main.activity: Family traditions exploration celebrating cultural diversity
visualSupports: Photos of diverse cultural celebrations: Christmas, Hanukkah, Eid, Diwali, Chinese New Year, birthdays, quinceañeras, powwows, etc.
Celebration gestures (clapping, arms up, happy movements)
Cultural food photos, music, decorations from different traditions

closing.activity: Students make celebration gesture and say 'Ma famille célèbre'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Families celebrate birthdays, holidays, have special meals and customs

lessons.title: Mon histoire familiale
lessons.oneGoal: Students can tell one simple story about their family

main.activity: Family storytelling with sequence support and visual aids
visualSupports: Story sequence cards showing family activities over time
Time gesture cards: yesterday (backward point), today (here point)
Family memory photo prompts
Simple story starter phrases on cards

closing.activity: Students show their memory picture and say 'Mon histoire'

lessons.realWorldConnection: People tell stories about their families and share memories

lessons.title: Je décris ma famille
lessons.oneGoal: Students can use simple descriptive words about family members

main.activity: Family description practice with inclusive, positive language
visualSupports: Family photos showing different sizes and ages positively
Size comparison gestures (tall, short) that are respectful
Kindness photos: hugging, helping, caring family moments
Description word cards with pictures and gestures

closing.activity: Students show family photo and share one positive description

lessons.realWorldConnection: When we talk about family, we describe what they look like and how they act

lessons.title: Les émotions en famille
lessons.oneGoal: Students can express how family makes them feel

main.activity: Family emotions exploration with emotional safety and support
visualSupports: Family emotion photos: laughing together, hugging, playing peacefully
Emotion face cards showing happy, content, loved feelings
Feeling flower template with petals for different emotions
Gesture cards for each emotion word

closing.activity: Students hug themselves and say 'Je suis aimé dans ma famille'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Families make us feel loved, happy, safe, and sometimes other emotions too

lessons.title: Créer notre livre de famille
lessons.oneGoal: Students begin creating a simple family book with pictures and words

main.activity: Family book creation project with scaffolded writing support
visualSupports: Family book examples showing different styles and contents
Book-making materials clearly organized
Page planning template with picture/word spaces
French word labels available for students to copy

closing.activity: Students hold their book cover and say 'Mon livre de famille'

lessons.realWorldConnection: People create photo albums and books to remember and share family memories

lessons.title: Mon arbre généalogique
lessons.oneGoal: Students create a simple family tree showing relationships

main.activity: Family tree creation with inclusive, diverse family structures
visualSupports: Family tree examples showing single parents, grandparents, step-families, adopted families, etc.
Tree templates with flexible branching for different family structures
Family relationship picture cards
Examples of creative family trees (not just traditional format)

closing.activity: Students point to their family tree and say 'Mon arbre de famille'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Family trees help people understand how family members are related

lessons.title: Partager nos familles
lessons.oneGoal: Students practice presenting their family information to others

main.activity: Presentation preparation with confidence-building supports
visualSupports: Presentation example videos or photos of children sharing
Gesture cards for presenting vocabulary
Simple French phrases for presentations on chart
Visual cues for good presentation skills

closing.activity: Students practice presentation opening: 'Voici ma famille'

lessons.realWorldConnection: People enjoy sharing and learning about each other's families

lessons.title: Célébration des familles
lessons.oneGoal: Students demonstrate their French family vocabulary through presentations and celebration

main.activity: Culminating family celebration with presentations and reflection
visualSupports: Celebration decorations honoring family diversity
Presentation area with special chair or podium
Photo documentation of student presentations
Celebration music from different cultures

closing.activity: Group celebration: 'Nos familles sont belles et spéciales!'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Communities celebrate diversity and the importance of families

lessons.title: Jeux de rôle familiaux
lessons.oneGoal: Students practice family vocabulary through dramatic play and role-playing

main.activity: Family dramatic play with French vocabulary reinforcement
visualSupports: Role-play props representing different cultures and family structures
French vocabulary cards displayed in play area
Family scenario cards for inspiration
Costumes or accessories representing different family roles

closing.activity: Students share one French word they used during family play

lessons.realWorldConnection: Playing family helps children understand family roles and relationships

lessons.title: Album photo familial
lessons.oneGoal: Students create detailed family photo albums with French captions

main.activity: Family photo album creation with French captioning practice
visualSupports: Album page templates with spaces for photos and captions
French family vocabulary word bank displayed
Example photo albums with French captions
Cultural decorating materials representing diversity

closing.activity: Students show one photo album page and read the French caption

lessons.realWorldConnection: Family photo albums preserve memories and help tell family stories

lessons.title: Interviews avec la famille
lessons.oneGoal: Students practice asking family members questions in French

main.activity: Family interview practice with simple French questions
visualSupports: French question cards with pictures and pronunciation guides
Interview clipboard prop for role-play
Family photos to prompt questions
Question intonation gesture cues

closing.activity: Students practice asking one interview question to the class

lessons.realWorldConnection: People ask questions to learn more about their family history and members

lessons.title: Familles du monde
lessons.oneGoal: Students explore how families are similar and different around the world

main.activity: Global family exploration celebrating worldwide family diversity
visualSupports: Family photos from diverse countries and cultures
World map for family traditions mapping
'Family' word in different languages chart
Cultural family tradition photos and artifacts

closing.activity: Students point to world map and say 'Families everywhere!' in French

lessons.realWorldConnection: Families exist in every culture with both universal and unique characteristics

lessons.title: Chansons et comptines familiales
lessons.oneGoal: Students learn and sing French songs about families

main.activity: French family songs and rhymes with movement and cultural elements
visualSupports: Song lyrics with pictures for vocabulary support
Action cards showing movements for songs
Musical instruments for accompaniment
Video examples of French family songs

closing.activity: Students sing one line of French family song together

lessons.realWorldConnection: Songs and rhymes are traditional ways families share language and culture

lessons.title: Exposition des familles
lessons.oneGoal: Students create a final exhibition showcasing their family learning and books

main.activity: Culminating family exhibition preparation and celebration
visualSupports: Exhibition display boards and tables
French vocabulary journey timeline
Student work from all 20 lessons organized attractively
Multilingual welcome signs for families

closing.activity: Students tour exhibition and celebrate: 'J'ai appris beaucoup sur les familles!'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Museums and exhibitions help people learn about and celebrate different families and cultures
